title: Asset
description: A generic asset entity for DAM/MAM systems.

status.description: Status of the asset (e.g., active, archived).

schema_version.description: Version of the asset schema used to create this record. Follows semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0'). Optional but recommended for evolution and compatibility checks.

extensions.description: Extension point for custom fields or plugin data. Keys SHOULD be prefixed with 'x_' or 'custom_' to avoid collision with future standard fields.

files.description: Embedded file objects for this asset.

type.description: File type (e.g., video, audio, image, document).

role.description: Role this file plays in the asset (free-form). Conventional values: 'essence' (primary media content), 'proxy' (lower-resolution derivative), 'thumbnail', 'sidecar' (companion non-media file, e.g. camera metadata). Legacy 1.1 grouping: files in one asset sharing the same role form a single logical media group. This legacy rule cannot represent every independent rendition or track.

uri.description: URI or path to the file.

checksum.description: Checksum or hash of the file.

derivatives.description: List of embedded derivative file objects.

storage_location.description: Embedded storage location object for this file. It records one location; it need not list every copy.

metadata_sets.description: Embedded metadata set objects for this asset.

collections.description: Embedded collection objects for this asset.

temporal_annotations.description: Time-based markers, segments, and annotations for this asset.

StorageLocation.description: An embedded storage location object. It has the same meaning as the standalone storage location schema, but its property set is closed: it accepts no extra properties and has no schema_version or extensions. Its connection_details object is opaque and does not authorize a connection.

MetadataSet.description: An embedded metadata set object. Unlike the standalone metadata set schema, it requires set_id and declares a field value with no defined representation.

Collection.description: An embedded collection object. Unlike the standalone collection schema, its assets array accepts items of any JSON type. A collection is a logical grouping and need not match a storage folder.

TemporalAnnotation.description: Time-based marker, segment, or annotation for video/audio assets.

source_id.description: Identifier of this annotation as assigned by the system that produced the record. This schema does not define its namespace or require any particular source system.

name.description: Display name or title of the marker

category.description: Category label as recorded by the source, kept as free-form text (e.g., 'Shot Sheet', 'Marker'). It is raw source data, not a standardized classification.

annotation_type.description: Legacy 1.x classification token: 'Generic', 'Comments', 'QualityControlMarker', or 'Transcription'. The tokens define no destination behavior. The default 'Generic' is a schema annotation for legacy readers, not proof of equivalent meaning; validators do not insert it.

start_timecode.description: Start position as SMPTE timecode (HH:MM:SS[:FF] or H:MM:SS'FF)

frame_rate.description: Frame rate used for timecode conversion

is_point_marker.description: True if this is a point marker (single moment, no duration)
